workflow.name: D1 Crota terrain native VS signatures v1

source_consumer_crosscheck: Charm's D1 terrain vertex reader independently defines the actual 0x08/0x0C payload interpretation: Vertices1 is raw int16x4 terrain position; Vertices2 is padded int16x4 normal with XYZ normalized by 32767 followed by half2 UV. Charm's DXBC signature component-count helper explicitly treats XYZ as four stored components because it is padded to four. Therefore the native width sequence corroborates the exact source reader without assigning source-language names to PS4 native semantic link IDs.
proof_boundary: Native PS4 semantic bytes remain numeric link IDs. This checkpoint proves the selected material -> ROI +0x28 vertex shader -> native Gnmx signature chain and its complete coverage; exact terrain attribute naming comes from the independent pinned D1 terrain consumer, not from guessed native semantic numbers.
